newsitem.title: USA: NY Pataki sets Thursday news conference on budget.
newsitem.headline: NY Pataki sets Thursday news conference on budget.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki, who plans a multi-year program to cut property taxes by hundreds of millions of dollars, said Thursday more budget information will be disclosed at a morning news conference.
The news conference, scheduled for 1030 EST, was expected to cover "major budget inititatives," according to a statement released by his office.
No further details were immediately available.
And at around noon, Assembly Speaker Sheldon Silver, D-Manhattan, plans to hold a news conference to discuss the one-week moratorium on retail clothing sales taxes in mid-January.
